title: Running clubs in Kochi
description: Find Kochi running groups and their own pages for the latest meetup details.
intro: These clubs publish information about their running communities in and around Kochi. Schedules and meeting points can change; check the club’s latest updates before heading out. The list is alphabetical and is not a ranking.

entries.name: Dawnage Run Club
entries.description: The club describes weekend group runs in Kochi followed by fitness activities. Its official page welcomes both new and experienced participants; ask the club for the latest meeting details.

entries.name: Kochi Run Club
entries.description: A third-party running directory lists this group and previous community runs from Panampilly Park. Its current schedule and ownership have not been independently verified; check with the group before setting out.

entries.name: Orange Runners & Riders Club
entries.description: The Kochi-based club describes running and cycling activities, including its Saturday Kochi Island Run. Contact the group through its site to confirm the next session and any joining requirements.

entries.name: Soles of Cochin
entries.description: This community organizes informal runs around Kochi. Its running page explains that start times and locations are shared in its Facebook group, usually shortly before a run.
